mutations.name: AT-MUT
mutations._mechanism: skill-candidates (c): GREEN stops asking for mutation rows; every row falls back to the orchestrator.

mutations.name: AT-MUT-RED
mutations._mechanism: ask RED for rows too; RED has no guard yet, so the request is noise that invites fake rows.

mutations.name: AT-MUT-WIRE
mutations._mechanism: connection removal: --mutation-spec is parsed but never passed to assemble().

mutations.name: CX-MUT-ANCHORS
mutations._mechanism: drop the --check-anchors requirement; a full harness run (which writes mutants into production code) would pass the Phase-5 gate.
mutations.find: return ("--check-anchors" in args and bool(specs)  # M:CX-MUT-ANCHORS

mutations.name: CX-MUT-WITHIN
mutations._mechanism: drop the inside-the-project check on spec paths.
mutations.find: and all(_path_within(spec, root) for spec in specs))
